summary: Widget mlp-playground written to src/widgets/mlp-playground.js. Controls (DOM order): dataset select (circles/moons/xor/spiral), noise 0-0.3, hidden layers 0-3, units 1-32, activation select (ReLU/leaky/tanh/sigmoid/none), optimiser select (GD/momentum/Adam), log learning rate 0.001-10, steps per frame 1-20, seed number input, show-test-points checkbox, buttons Play/Pause, Step, Reset weights, New data. Default: circles, noise 0.05, 1x8 ReLU, Adam 0.03, 1 step/frame, seed 1, paused on the random initial boundary (loss 0.7081, 51.5%/58.0%, 33 params, 0/8 dead); Play closes a polygon around the inner disc (100% train by about step 430 in headless Chrome, loss 0.0049 at step 434), with 8 half-plane ramp thumbnails. Numbers checked against an independent Python/NumPy reimplementation with exact mulberry32/Box-Muller streams (scratch/mlp_ref.py): step 0 default and 9 other states (default 60 steps; spiral 2x16 200 steps; moons noise .2 tanh 3x5 GD .3; xor leaky momentum 2x4 seed 7; sigmoid GD lr 3; none 3x8; 0 layers xor; Adam lr 10 with 12/16 dead; GD lr 10 with 16/16 dead, loss 1.044) all agree to the displayed 4 digits (train/test loss, train/test accuracy, params, dead units). Divergence message verified.
changes: Round axis ticks on loss chart, hint wording tuned after screenshots
issues: Spiral test set uses i+U(0,1) along the arc (spec's formula would make it identical to the training set at noise 0).
Initialisation uses a separate stream AIW.rng(seed+5000); documented in file header, mirrored in Python.

With 0 hidden layers the units and activation controls are disabled by design; widget-test reports activation/optimiser/seed/checkbox as 'unchanged' only because its drive cycle restores the original value (verified by probe that each changes the output).
Play auto-pauses at loss < 1e-4 or 20,000 steps.
Chinese strings use GLOSSARY terms; Chinese 400 px and English layouts read clean, no overlap.
